summary: Phase 60 follow-up fixes verified on TEST school (Fees Demo). Fix (1) BulkEnrolDialog Note column now shows 'Pick a class/section' when no class chosen and 'Pick a section' when class has sections but none chosen (never 'Ready' in those states); Confirm button stays disabled until both chosen. Fix (2) invite-parent reason text uses 'no phone' (never 'no no phone') — verified via live POST invite + bulk-run inspection, and via code at server.py:6277 + phase59.py:96 (both use .replace('skipped_no_', 'no ') before .replace('_', ' ')).
critical_code_review_comments: BulkEnrolDialog.jsx: the current row <select> encodes class||section in a single value, so the UI can't produce the 'class chosen, section cleared' state on its own — it only arises when the server preview seeds it (class='Grade 4', section=null). This is fine for the current flows but means the amber 'Pick a section' hint can only be exercised via the preview-provided state, not by user action in the dialog. Consider splitting into two selects if class-only + no-section inputs ever need to be chosen manually.
server.py:6277 and phase59.py:96 duplicate the same channel-reason formatting logic (replace chain). Extract into a shared helper to avoid future drift of the two call sites.
test_credentials: admin@feesdemo.test / admin123 at /login/p50demo (Fees Demo School TEST)
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one QAP60 NEnrol student (FDS-GX-001) in Fees Demo TEST school via /api/students/enroll (enroll=false) + PUT /api/res/students/{id} to set class_name='Grade 4', section=null, enrollment_status='not_enrolled'. Student cleaned up after test. Also triggered a fresh parent_invite bulk run on existing Emma EmailOnly student (bulk_run_id 13ed4497-b964-4eb6-b779-14e0179df9b3) to verify reason text; no email was sent (sms-only channel which was skipped as 'No phone — select Email').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix (1) verified in UI: initial 'Pick a section' (class=Grade 4, section=null from preview), cleared → 'Pick a class/section', Grade 4||A → 'Ready' + Confirm enabled. Fix (2) verified: Emma EmailOnly invite with channels=['sms'] produced reason 'No phone — select Email' (no 'no no'). Code path for mixed-channel 'sms: no phone' output (line 96 phase59.py / 6277 server.py) uses .replace('skipped_no_', 'no ') before .replace('_', ' ') so output is clean. QAP60 was cleaned up; LPGS untouched; no email-channel invites sent.
rca of the issue: Fix 2 original bug: the replace chain was previously only .replace('skipped_', 'skipped ').replace('_', ' '), turning 'skipped_no_phone' → 'skipped no_phone' → 'skipped no phone' or into 'no no phone' depending on earlier variants. Fixed by adding .replace('skipped_no_', 'no ') FIRST, which collapses the 'skipped_no_<x>' prefix directly to 'no <x>'. Fix 1 original bug: Note cell fell through to 'Ready' whenever r.warning was empty, even if class/section were missing; new conditions explicitly check !r.class_name and (classes with sections present & !r.section) and emit the amber hints before falling back to Ready.
